headline: Marban Hollow Erupts as Violent Clashes Rake Contested Fronts
war_summary: Since our previous dispatch, the calm over Marban Hollow has shattered in spectacular fashion, erupting into furious contest with eight base turnovers in the past two hours alone centered upon Checkpoint Bua as enlistments and casualties surged. Weathered Expanse endures as an unrelenting meat grinder, logging six fresh base changes across Crow’s Nest and Wightwalk alongside nearly 2,800 combined casualties over the same span. Palantine Berm has likewise reignited, recording five rapid transfers between Vendett and Windburn Landing as both factions trade heavy blows. While Linn of Mercy’s ground exchanges paused after earlier upheavals, fighting there remains catastrophic with over 5,200 casualties reported in two hours. Fresh contention has also flared in the Gutter, where three base shifts struck Suojus and Lost Kaivo, while a sudden rush of fighting in Farranac Coast stripped Colonial control of Transient Valley. Farther west, Stonecradle saw three shifts at The Dais, and Morgens Crossing absorbed severe bombardment without territorial change, leaving multiple sectors locked in fluid, high-casualty skirmishes.
